name: strings
purpose: Extract and print human-readable character sequences from a compiled binary file.
explanation: Referenced in C07 when inspecting compiled binaries: raw binary files contain non-printable machine code bytes, so `strings` displays readable ASCII text embedded in the binary without garbled terminal output.

parameters.description: Path to the compiled binary or executable.

explanationOfOutput: Outputs printable text sequences found inside `a.out`, piped to `head` to show the first 10 lines.
whenToUse: When inspecting compiled executables or binary files safely in the terminal.
commonMistakes: Running plain `cat` on a compiled binary, which prints garbled non-printable characters.
